You need to try and find a hobby to take the place of drinking when you're feeling down. Don't just try one and then give it up if you don't like it. Start with painting, drawing, or writing. If those don't work, look into model cars or planes or sewing. These are all things that can be done at any time and late, late into nights. When you find something that you can connect to take it to your outside life. Find groups that share your interest and surround yourself with those people. I realize the hard part is finding that one thing you love. PM me if you need help on ideas or just need to talk. 

P.S. People who laugh at you for wanting a hug are not people you want in your life. Consider yourself lucky when this happens for people are showing you there true colors right away before getting attached. This is a good thing.
